hook: Tri Dao's PhD work at Stanford, co-advised by Christopher Re and Stefano Ermon, produced FlashAttention, a fast, memory-efficient attention algorithm that cut a Transformer's memory use from quadratic to linear in sequence length. Presented at NeurIPS in 2022 and later extended in FlashAttention-2 and FlashAttention-3, it became a piece of infrastructure that most large language models now train and run on. He joined Together AI as a co-founder and Chief Scientist around the time he finished his PhD, and is also an Assistant Professor of Computer Science at Princeton University, where he leads the Dao AI Lab.

achievements.title: FlashAttention
achievements.impact: Co-authored the NeurIPS 2022 paper introducing an IO-aware exact attention algorithm that cut Transformer attention memory use from quadratic to linear in sequence length, now a standard component of large language model training and inference.

achievements.title: FlashAttention-2
achievements.impact: Extended the original algorithm to reach up to 72 percent of theoretical FLOP utilization on NVIDIA A100 GPUs, roughly doubling core attention speed over the first version, per Together AI's own announcement.

achievements.title: Chief Scientist and co-founder, Together AI
achievements.impact: Directs technical work aimed at making open-source AI models more accessible and cost-competitive with closed alternatives, per his own site.

achievements.title: Assistant Professor, Princeton University
achievements.impact: Leads the Dao AI Lab, continuing research on efficient systems for training and serving large models.
